rejected_claims.reason: Grading patterns are prose-specific to the teacher run ('sum of the query-term weights', 'ranked by descending score') and too narrow for reliable lexical matching; the aggregation/ranking procedure it asserts depends on non-deterministic paraphrase rather than a stable, checkable fact.

Patterns require verbatim transcription of formulas with idiosyncratic notation and spacing ('CFW(i) = log N - log n', 'NDL(j) = DL(j) / Average DL'), which is not deterministic enough for lexical grading; no run could extract primary-source text corroborating this exact notation.
